# Pal Wabuson

> Pal Wabuson leads enterprise AI transformation and implementation: helping organisations move from AI experiments to AI that changes how work gets done, by redesigning workflows so people lead, AI assists and automation is used where it is safe, then measuring and scaling the result. He is an AI engineer in Nigeria and the founder of Unovia Technologies, an African technology company building practical AI products (Vera, Iris and Lana), and a TEDx speaker on artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship and the future of African business.

Contact: hello@palwabuson.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pal-wabuson-948168234/
Company: https://unovia.ai

## Enterprise AI transformation

- [Enterprise AI transformation](https://palwabuson.com/#enterprise): opportunity assessment, workflow redesign before technology, implementation with owners and success measures, and adoption across teams.
- [Case study: 1159 Realty](https://palwabuson.com/#case-study): AI-assisted hiring redesigned at 1159 Realty. The first pilot narrowed 34 applicants to 4 human interviews; it became the HR team's standing practice (179 candidates, 66 interview reports) and was scaled, as Vera, to about 10 HR teams. Includes a review from the HR Manager.
- [Case study: House 12 Workspace and Lifestyle](https://palwabuson.com/#case-study-lana): a coworking space that ran memberships on paper moved its daily operations (plans, QR check-in, renewals, payments, reminders, staff roles) onto one system. That system became Lana. Includes a video review.

## Products

- [Vera](https://vera.unovia.ai): AI recruitment: CV screening, live first-stage voice interviews and evidence-based reports.
- [Iris](https://iris.unovia.ai): AI interview practice, CV improvement and job discovery.
- [Lana](https://lana.unovia.ai): AI workspace management for coworking, gyms, studios and shortlets.

## Hire an AI engineer in Nigeria

- [AI engineer in Nigeria: AI agent development](https://palwabuson.com/ai-engineer-nigeria.html): AI agents for customer support on WhatsApp, Instagram and web chat; sales and lead qualification; operations and back-office automation; orders, payments and collections; internal knowledge assistants; and HR and recruitment. Projects start with one workflow, a working prototype and measurable results.

## Guides to AI agents in Nigeria

- [How to build AI agents in Nigeria](https://palwabuson.com/articles/how-to-build-ai-agents-in-nigeria.html): a step-by-step guide covering use-case selection, WhatsApp Business Platform, model choice, tools, local languages, dollar-priced costs, power and connectivity, guardrails and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
- [How AI agents can profit your business in Nigeria](https://palwabuson.com/articles/how-ai-agents-can-profit-your-business-in-nigeria.html): five profit levers, industry examples, a simple ROI method, costs and when not to build.
- [How to hire the best AI engineer in Nigeria](https://palwabuson.com/articles/how-to-hire-the-best-ai-engineer-in-nigeria.html): signs of a strong AI engineer, questions to ask, red flags and what to prepare.
